# Security policy

## Reporting a security problem

Never report a security problem in a public issue, discussion or pull request, because everything posted there is public. Report it privately with the Report a vulnerability button on this repository's [Security page](https://github.com/adamNBurke/job-search-prioritizer/security).

A security problem here means something like a job posting that makes the tool run a command, the tool sending your data somewhere the [README](../README.md#what-it-will-not-do) does not list, or the tool writing outside your data folder.

In the report, say what you found, the steps that show it, and the plugin version. Leave out your resume and any file from your data folder.

## Supported versions

Only the latest release gets security fixes. A fix ships in a new point release, listed in the [CHANGELOG](../CHANGELOG.md).

## What to expect

I maintain this in my spare time. No response time is promised.
